primarySourceInterpretation: EPA distinguishes total species counts, measurements on individual organisms, summaries of collected individuals, tissue analysis and toxicity testing. These different intents require different occurrence interpretation; Count/count with Population Census is one admissible form, not the entire biological record vocabulary.
observedCandidateForms: Two Potamogeton records explicitly report Taxon Present (Y/N) (choice list) = Y in Final Actual field observations.
Silver carp includes Final Individual fish length/weight and Individual/Group Summary counts.
Round goby includes Individual length records as well as tissue chemical measurements; tissue analyte values must not be mistaken for organism counts.
proposedReview: Evaluate positive individual measurements, positive group counts/weights and explicit Y with exact taxon, complete source identity, original collection date, verified field-sample location and no laboratory, transplant or toxicity context. Preserve original fields and qualifying-form labels. Do not re-label negative, zero, tissue analyte, incomplete or unreviewed rows as absence.
